objective: Production keeps collecting, storing, backing up, and deploying when the local computer is off or the external drive is unplugged. The external warehouse mirror is monitored downstream durability, not a runtime dependency.
successDefinition: If the local computer is off and the external drive is unplugged for a week, production still collects data, deploys when server-side proof is fresh, stores backups locally, alerts that the mirror is stale, and catches the external warehouse up when it returns.
nonDependencyRules: External warehouse mirror absence must not stop production collectors.
External warehouse mirror absence must not block deployments when production-local backup and restore proof are fresh.
External warehouse mirror lag is warning-level by default, not a runtime blocker.
Destructive pruning remains disabled unless production-local archive, backup, restore, dry-run, approval, and post-prune verification gates pass.

durabilityTiers.name: Production database
durabilityTiers.role: Active source of truth for live application state and collected records.

durabilityTiers.name: Production-local backup/archive
durabilityTiers.role: Server-side recovery layer for backups, archive bundles, manifests, and restore proof.

durabilityTiers.name: External warehouse mirror
durabilityTiers.role: Off-server durability and long-term mirror that catches up when connected.

durabilityTiers.name: Historical cold archive
durabilityTiers.role: Optional deep retention and long-horizon evidence archive.

requires: rollback or migration proof when schema changed
